content:
jess: T-minus 45 for EU change window. Readiness check — we're in quiet slice. Current plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full. Requesting pin for service-image v2.14.1 to avoid the latest autoscaler change.
omar: On it. I just created the pin in deploybot, will confirm output.
deploy-bot: pin created by @omar: service-image@v2.14.1 pinned for slice eu-west-1 (pin id: pin-20260321-07). Canary rollout scheduled at t+10m.
linh: Quick smoke checklist: healthcheck, latency <120ms p95, error rate <0.1%. I've queued a smoke job.
jess: Also adding rollback conditions: if canary error rate >0.5% for 5m OR any unrecoverable 5xx spike, we abort and back out to v2.13.0.
product-mike: Heads-up: feature flags ff-regen-embeddings toggled on canary only. If we need rollback, flip flag off before unpin.
sre-ops: Who's on rollback owner? I'll be standby. Omar pls hold the unpin key.
omar: I have the unpin key and will run the backout if we hit thresholds. Sharing commands now:

```
# immediate backout (fast):
deploy-bot unpin --pin-id pin-20260321-07 --slice eu-west-1
deploy-bot promote --image service-image@v2.13.0 --slice eu-west-1
```

For graceful rollback (drain traffic):
```
deploy-bot split-traffic --slice eu-west-1 --from v2.14.1 --to v2.13.0 --percent 20 --over 5m
```

jess: Also add DB migration note: no schema changes in this deploy. Good.
linh: Smoke job running: basic GETs ✅, auth flows ✅, embeddings pipeline limited sample ✅. Latency p95 ~98ms.
deploy-bot: canary started (task id cb-9876). Observability links: https://console.redwood/integrations/rollouts/cb-9876
product-mike: :eyes: I'll watch for model regen anomalies.
sre-ops: If we need to escalate, use channel #release-war-room and call on-call.
omar: reminder: if we abort, please also patch release notes with the rollback reason and tag the github issue.
jess: last check — any exemptions to freeze? ops-tooling patch is safe; request an exemption for patches to deploy scripts and pin management.
linh: approved from QA for this patch. :thumbsup:
product-mike: approved for feature flag gating. No customer-impacting changes expected.
sre-ops: approved for tooling patch. Logging and audit preserved.
jess: OK, moving to canary in 5m. Keep eyes on deploy-bot link and smoke metrics. Ping here immediately on any red.
omar: Roger. I'll stay on call for 20m post-canary.
deploy-bot: Canary 10% traffic shift complete. Monitoring...
sre-ops: metrics stable at 0.03% errors; latency p95 steady at 102ms. Holding.
product-mike: No anomalies from user metrics. Proceed to 50% in 10m? jess say go.
jess: GO for 50%.
deploy-bot: Traffic split update: 50% -> v2.14.1 in eu-west-1 succeeded.
sre-ops: 10m hold. All green so far.
linh: running extended regression set now (4m window).
linh: regression set passes. :white_check_mark: 
jess: OK, full rollout after 5m unless we see blips. Thank you everyone — documented pin id pin-20260321-07 and rollback commands in the release note draft.
omar: jotting final notes and will update the release issue.
product-mike: adding a short blurb for internal release notes about the pin and the feature flag.
sre-ops: Stand down in 25m after post-rollout verification unless we see issues.
